description: Extract public reviews for one or more Google Workspace Marketplace apps by App ID or app URL. No login, API key or proxy needed.

appIds.description: One or more Google Workspace Marketplace apps. Paste numeric App IDs (e.g. 539341275670) or full app URLs. Duplicate IDs are removed automatically.
appIds.sectionDescription: Each app is scraped separately and its reviews are combined in one dataset.
appIds.title: App IDs or app URLs

maxItems.description: Maximum number of reviews to save across all apps.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Caps keep runs fast and predictable. Unused slots are offered to the next app.
maxItems.title: Max reviews (total)

maxRating.description: Only include reviews with this rating or lower (1-5). Use 2 to collect complaints only. Leave empty for all ratings.
maxRating.title: Maximum star rating

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Maximum reviews to save for any single app. Raise this to scan deeper for sparse filters or rating sorts.
maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app

minRating.description: Only include reviews with this rating or higher (1-5). Leave empty for all ratings.
minRating.title: Minimum star rating

reviewKeyword.description: Case-insensitive text that must appear in the review. Useful for complaints, feature names or product terms. Leave empty for all reviews.
reviewKeyword.title: Review text contains

reviewLanguage.description: The Marketplace serves reviews one language at a time. Pick a language for a complete slice, or All languages for the mixed stream the site shows under 'All languages'.
reviewLanguage.title: Review language

sinceDate.description: Only reviews posted on or after this date. Use an ISO date (2026-01-01), an ISO datetime, or a relative period such as '30 days', '2 weeks' or '6 months'.
sinceDate.title: Reviews from

sortBy.description: Most relevant and Most helpful use Google's helpful ranking. Newest uses the date ranking. Highest rated and Lowest rated sort the fetched reviews in the actor; increase Max reviews per app to widen the window.
sortBy.sectionDescription: All filters are applied to the reviews that the Marketplace serves for the selected language.
sortBy.title: Sort reviews by

untilDate.description: Only reviews posted on or before this date. Use an ISO date (2026-12-31) or an ISO datetime. A bare date includes the whole day.
untilDate.title: Reviews until

title: Google Workspace Marketplace App Review Extractor Input
